  Issue: When the body's non-blank-line array is empty (e.g., a body of only whitespace), `first` on an empty array raises "first/1 (null) has no element", which currently relies on `2>/dev/null || true` to silence. The `first // ""` fallback does not catch this error path because `//` only catches null, not raised errors.
  Suggested minimal fix: Replace `map(select(test("\\S"))) | first // ""` with `[map(select(test("\\S")))[0]] | first // ""` (jq's `first` on `[null]` returns null, which `// ""` catches). Alternatively, use `[map(select(test("\\S"))) | .[0] // ""]`.
